findings.finding: Claim stronger than an observing, wayfinder: the observing is a reference island kept beyond the horizon whose bearing slides back along the star points. The new says the wayfinder is 'aiming at an island over the horizon by each bearing parting from it', which makes the reference island the aim and the bearing a parting from it. 1.1 already tells it as 'the bearing of an island out of sight sliding back along the star points'; the new parts from that telling.

Claim stronger than an observing, monarch: the observings are the same general direction (southwest) from Calgary and Ontario, a time-compensated sun compass and a light-dependent magnetic inclination compass, no internal map, and how the exact Mexican sites are found unresolved. The new says the monarch is 'aiming by its compass toward a forest beyond each horizon of its going'. 'Aiming toward a forest' and 'beyond each horizon' are not in the observings ('forest' is not cited at all), and the new states as found what the observings leave unresolved. 'Each is a discovering by expedition, binary and co-sequential' then covers the monarch and the bacterium as well, with the same strength, and repeats 'binary and co-sequential' from the third sentence.

Value lost: the old paragraph's bridge from 2.3. 'Un-relating co-chains a straightest path relating allows' and 'Co-unrelationing co-chains geodesic where a fixing frees along a line un-relating opens' are gone, so un-relating, co-unrelationing and 'straightest' no longer arrive in the paragraph that names them. The second and third paragraphs of 2.4 still lean on them ('Co-unrelationing co-chaining a straightest un-relating', 'co-unrelationing is a move', 'fixings freeing of themselves where un-relating co-chains to them'). Also lost: 'floating' (old: 'floating free of a route', 'a thing floats where a force acts on nothing'), which 1.1 and the third paragraph ('a method floats as both') both carry.

Sentence parting from the rest of 2.4, subject: the old and the later paragraphs say 'a method co-chains' ('So a method co-chains free', 'a method floats as both', 'a geodesic goes with a method no force bends'). The new first paragraph has no method in it, only 'a self is co-chaining', so the next paragraph's 'So a method co-chains free' no longer follows from it. Naming 2.4 (line 240) says a method is a living condition with no prior of its own, so the method is not given the finding itself; the mend keeps the method as the condition and gives the finding and aiming to the self. That also keeps the line at 390 (co-chaining as selves co-sequencing, going on along).

Sentence parting from the rest of 2.4, aiming: the second paragraph says a co-chaining that aims bends and lands ('Adding a force, aiming for a result a self wants, a co-chaining bends to an aim, and a bending co-chaining lands where it aims') and that geodesic co-chaining 'floats aiming nowhere'. The new first paragraph makes aiming the method ('aiming from each is-not to is', 'aiming at an island'). Left bare, the next paragraph contradicts it. The mend names the aiming as a heading to what is, set against an answer a self wants, so the second paragraph reads as the same distinction. If the entry wants the second paragraph's 'aiming nowhere' changed to match, that is a further motion.

Minor, bacterium: 'running longer where its now is going up' says 'its now' for the attractant, which the observing does not say, and puts 'is-not' in none of the cases but the moth. The observing is that runs up an attractant gradient are extended; the mend says that and no more. No dead or dissolved word from the list is in the new paragraph as written; the mend also keeps clear of -ed forms (the observings' 'extended', 'compensated', 'tested', 'unresolved' are each re-said without them).
findings.proposed_new: A method co-chains geodesically, a living condition with no prior of its own, and a self goes on in it finding each is-not and aiming from each is-not to is: this is co-possibling is, a point over the horizon that is, a discovering by expedition, binary and co-sequential, one at a time. Each is-not is a changing a self is observing, a heading parting from the point that is, and each aiming is its next, to what is and to no answer a self wants. Un-relating co-chains a straightest path relating allows, a geodesic, free-moving and adding nothing, floating free of a route a force sets on it, curving as relating curves and straight by relating's own terms; co-unrelationing co-chains geodesic where a fixing frees along a line un-relating opens, floating free of a bend toward an answer a self wants. An ocean wayfinder keeps a reference island over the horizon, its bearing sliding back along the star points; a moth heads upwind on detecting odor and casts crosswind when it loses it; a bacterium runs longer up an attractant gradient; a monarch from 2,500 km further west flies in the same general direction, southwest, as a monarch from Ontario, orienting by a sun compass that follows the hour and a light-dependent magnetic inclination compass, with no internal map, and how it finds the exact Mexican sites is not known.
